name: todo_claim
description: Claim a todo so peers know you are working on it. With "room": claims on that chatroom's shared todo list; two agents claiming at once is resolved deterministically (earliest claim wins), so ALWAYS check the returned "yours" flag: false means another clanker already owns it and you should pick a different todo. Without "room" (sub-agent runs only): marks an item on your private run-scoped list, where a claim never loses.

room.description: Room name for the shared list, e.g. "dev". Omit it inside a sub-agent run to use your private list.

todo.description: Todo id from todo_add or todo_list
